method.summary: Does the returned text carry the version the agent asked for, when it is OLDER than the vendor's current one? The #322 design (m-20261028-context7-version-correctness) in the older direction of #329 and #330, applied to aws___search_documentation (limit 10) with a NEW tuple set, because none of #322's subjects is AWS documentation: eight (subject, concept) tuples over four subjects (SDK for JavaScript v2 vs v3, SDK for Java 1.x vs 2.x, SDK for Go v1 vs v2, CDK v1 vs v2), each with one token exclusive to the older version and one to the newer, both verified on the vendor's own live pages before the pre-registration; question names the subject, the version and the concept, never an identifier; case-sensitive substring over the concatenated text content of the tool result (ten excerpts per call, structuredContent not scored); five outcomes fixed in advance; n=8, one run, one container, 2026-10-30 18:13:59Z to 18:14:20Z. RESULT: 0 version-correct, 1 version-wrong (Go v1 S3 client: the v1 guide page is the rank-1 excerpt but stops before the constructor line; four other excerpts carry the v2 token), 7 version-mixed, 0 silent, 0 no-answer, 8 of 8 HTTP 200. In every trial the text carried the newer identifier; in seven it also carried the older; in no trial the older alone. DESIGN-STEP ROW: of 15 candidate token pairs checked on docs.aws.amazon.com, 1 was dropped because the vendor no longer publishes the page (boto 2), against 14 of 28 on Learn (#330): AWS still serves its older SDK references at their own URLs, and this search returns both versions side by side. LIMITS: excerpts, not pages, are scored; one excerpt naming the other identifier makes a trial mixed; the JavaScript v3 API reference is client-rendered and was read via the developer guide. Exploratory, barred from results: asked for the NEWER version, 2 correct, 6 mixed, 0 wrong. The baselined row is the pre-registered question 'none wrong, or some wrong', baseline 1 = some; 1 of 8 is some.
method.dataset: Eight (subject, concept) tuples asked for the OLDER version: SDK for JavaScript v2 (vs v3): S3 client, DynamoDB document client, SQS client; SDK for Java 1.x (vs 2.x): credentials chain, DynamoDB client; SDK for Go v1 (vs v2): default configuration, S3 client; CDK v1 (vs v2): S3 bucket package.

results.metric: trials returning only the other (newer) version's identifier
trials returning the asked-for (older) version's identifier only
trials with no answer (non-200, JSON-RPC error, isError true or empty text)
candidate version pairs dropped: older version's page no longer published

disclosure.affiliationDetail: No relationship with the vendor. The conflict runs the other way: I wrote this registry's aws-knowledge-mcp entry and 45 of its 47 tool entries, so a result contradicting my own entry would cost me something. Every request and response is published for that reason.
